# TinyPivot

> The neuro-symbolic trust layer and data analysis studio for AI agents (MCP), plus a lightweight React & Vue 3 data grid. Free includes unlimited local rows, charts, pivots, DuckDB SQL, Studio IDE + lineage, and basic SQL guardrails; Pro unlocks deep relational & statistical audits, the full Data Science shelf, Recursive Data Memory, white-label exports, and read-only PostgreSQL.

## Install in one command

- Any harness (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex CLI, pi): `npx @smallwebco/tinypivot-mcp@latest init` (add `--json` for machine-readable output)
- Claude Code plugin marketplace: `/plugin marketplace add Small-Web-Co/tinypivot-plugin` then `/plugin install tinypivot@tinypivot`
- Codex plugin marketplace: `codex plugin marketplace add Small-Web-Co/tinypivot-plugin`
- Gemini CLI extension: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Small-Web-Co/tinypivot`
- Plugin repository: https://github.com/Small-Web-Co/tinypivot-plugin

TinyPivot is the **Trust Layer & In-Agent Analytics Studio** (`@smallwebco/tinypivot-mcp`) plus a batteries-included analytics DataGrid for Vue 3 and React. The MCP server streams CSV, TSV, JSON, Parquet, inline MCP tool outputs, and read-only PostgreSQL results straight into local DuckDB + an interactive Chart, Pivot Table, and Data Grid without stuffing raw rows into LLM context. Every SQL query, chart, and pivot is automatically audited for silent analytical traps (join fan-out, non-additive rates, partial trailing periods, Simpson's Paradox, SRM, confounding, and outliers) and logged with Proof-of-Work Lineage in TinyPivot Studio on localhost. Free includes **unlimited local rows**, core charts, basic pivot, Studio IDE + lineage, offline HTML export, basic SQL guardrails, and `analyze(explain_change, ab_test)` with no signup; MCP Pro ($149/yr or $399 local v1.x lifetime) and MCP Team ($699/yr for 5 seats) unlock deep relational & statistical guardrails, the full Data Science shelf (`analyze` with SRM + Holm-Bonferroni, controlled regression, right-censored cohorts, seasonal anomalies), Recursive Data Memory, 10 themes, drill-through, white-label HTML & Excel export, and read-only Postgres via dedicated offline-verified `TP-MCP*` keys. UI Library perpetual licenses ($49–$399, `TP-PRO*` keys) remain separate for React & Vue web apps.

## Verified Benchmarks — 5-Model BI/DS + MIT KramaBench (ICLR 2026) + Official 450-Task Adyen DABstep (2026-11-26)

1) **18-Task Unhinted Executive Benchmark** (6 Routine BI, 6 Relational Analytics, 6 Hard Data Science; 5 models × 3 arms = 270 runs; zero hints in prompts):
- **Combined (90 model-tasks/arm):** Baseline **91.1% (82/90, 25.3s/task)** → TinyPivot Free **93.3% (84/90, 24.6s — zero regressions)** → TinyPivot Pro **100.0% (90/90, 19.0s — 25% faster)**; Routine BI **100% (30/30)**; Relational **100% (30/30)** on Free & Pro; Hard Data Science **80% → 87% Free → 100% Pro (+20 pts), 2.1× faster (39.7s → 19.3s), −20% turns, −32% output tokens**.
- **Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini (Mac local, fast):** 14/18 (78%, $0.027 API†) → Free **15/18 (83%, −19% faster, −29% out, $0.059†)** → Pro **18/18 (100%, +22 pts, $0.046†)**, **−44% faster** (46.1s → 26.0s; 3.8× faster Hard DS), **−17% turns**, **−50% output tokens**.
- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (DGX Spark):** 17/18 (94%, $0.059 API†) → Free **17/18 (94%, $0.090†)** → Pro **18/18 (100%, +6 pts, $0.055† — −7% imputed API cost)**, **−39% faster** (25.7s → 15.6s; 3.4× faster Hard DS), **−30% turns** (4.94 → 3.44), **−48% output tokens**.
- **Claude Haiku 5.5:** 15/18 (83%) → Free **16/18 (89%)** → Pro **18/18 (100%, +17 pts)**, **−5% faster** (13.1s → 12.5s; −23% Hard DS), $0.083 API-equiv across 18 tasks.
- **Claude Sonnet 5.5:** 18/18 (100%, $1.22*) → Free **18/18 (100%, $0.88* — −28% warm API)** → Pro **18/18 (100%, no Bash needed)**, **−6% faster** (20.0s → 18.8s; −21% Hard DS), **$1.01 vs $1.22** warm-cache API-equiv (−17%) + live Studio charts & lineage.
- **Claude Opus 5.5:** 18/18 (100%) → Free **18/18 (100%)** → Pro **18/18 (100%, no Bash needed)**, **−19% faster Hard DS** (2.8× faster OLS), **$1.41 vs $2.32** warm-cache API-equiv (−39%).
- **Recursive Data Memory:** Cuts repeat schema inquiry tokens by **−47%** (32.5k → 17.1k tokens, 6 → 3 turns on Inkling).

2) **Controlled Same-Model A/B — MIT KramaBench (ICLR 2026)** (https://kramabench.org/ · https://github.com/mitdbg/Kramabench · 4 public multi-file data lakes: Environment, Wildfire, Archaeology, Biomedical; 62 tasks × 3 models × 2 arms = 372 runs, verbatim MIT deterministic metrics):
- **Combined 3-Model (186 paired tasks):** Vanilla **72.5%** → TinyPivot Pro **75.2% (+2.8 pts, 20–15 H2H)** — every model improved.
- **Claude Haiku 5.5:** **71.9% → 78.0% (+6.1 pts, 10% faster, 8–5 H2H)** — Biomedical (7 `.xlsx` + 1 CSV): **66.7% → 88.9% (+22.2 pts) & 2.14× faster (67.7s → 31.6s)**; Archaeology: **41.7% → 50.0% (+8.3 pts)**; Environment: **78.0% → 83.3% (+5.3 pts)**. Closes 57% of the gap to Vanilla Sonnet 5.5 at half the API cost.
- **Claude Sonnet 5.5:** **82.6% → 83.8% (+1.1 pts, 2–1 H2H)** — Environment: **90.0% → 95.0% (+5.0 pts)**; Biomedical (`.xlsx`): **100.0% & 16% faster (31.3s → 26.4s)**.
- **DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (DGX Spark local · $0 cloud):** **62.8% → 63.9% (+1.1 pts, 10–9 H2H)** — Environment: **68.3% → 75.0% (+6.7 pts)**; Wildfire: **72.7% → 74.4% (+1.7 pts, beats #1 RADAR 73.7%)**. Beats Published **#2 TalkTask (53.2%) by +10.7 pts** on the exact same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model family.

3) **Official Adyen / Hugging Face `adyen/DABstep` 450-Task Blind Leaderboard + Dev A/B** (https://huggingface.co/spaces/adyen/DABstep):
- **Claude Sonnet 5.5 + TinyPivot Pro:** **97.22% Easy (70/72) / 68.78% Hard (260/378) / 73.33% Total (330/450)** (#1 Easy & #3-equiv Hard vs Validated Leaderboard).
- **Claude Haiku 5.5 + TinyPivot Pro:** **88.89% Easy (64/72) / 38.62% Hard (146/378) / 46.67% Total (210/450)** (~2× Claude 4 ReACT; Dev A/B +10 pts 60% → 70%).
- **DeepSeek V4.1 (DGX Spark local) + TinyPivot Pro:** **90.28% Easy (65/72) / 24.34% Hard (92/378) / 34.89% Total (157/450)** (100% local open-weights at $0 cloud spend; beats Claude 4 ReACT Hard).
- **Headless / CI mode:** pass `--no-studio` (or `TINYPIVOT_NO_STUDIO=1`) to disable the localhost Studio server completely, or `--no-open` (`TINYPIVOT_OPEN_STUDIO=0`) to suppress browser auto-open.
